meta.source_event: v51 New Threat Intake Pack - CVE-2026-48907 Joomla JCE RCE

findings.title: Critical Unauthenticated RCE in Joomla Content Editor (JCE)
findings.description: Broken access control in Joomla JCE profile import endpoint allows unauthenticated upload and execution of a staged PHP webshell. The v51 brief describes a three-request chain: fetch public CSRF token, POST malicious .xml.php payload, then GET the staged path to trigger execution.
findings.mas_trm_mapping: MAS TRM Section 9 - Third-Party Risk Management
compensating_controls: Audit editor profiles and remove unauthorized profiles
Deploy WAF rule blocking option=com_jce and task=profiles.import
Restore from a clean pre-2026-06-03 backup if compromise is suspected
